title: the-chart-deposit-is-a-codemother-verb
intention: Depositing a berthed chart packet back into its tree is codemother acting, so codemother answers it on the bus: two new verbs on CodeMotherDevice, `deposit` (body {berth, nexus?}: land one berthed stage or verdict packet in its nexus and reply with what landed) and `drain` (body {}: land every verdict the PROVED crossing enqueued and nobody deposited, reply one entry per berth). The deposit code moves from skills/chart/live.py into codemother's own new module cairn/devices/codemother/deposit.py, and skills/chart/live.py's `learn` and its drain-before-serving ask codemother over the bus instead of importing nine codemother machines. live.py's embeds for counsel and moreabout ask inference_domain's `resolve` verb directly instead of importing cairn/devices/librarian/live.py. The CLI words (`learn`, `counsel`, `moreabout`, `chain`) and what each prints are unchanged.
why: RULE 1 child: skills/chart/live.py imports nine of codemother's machines to deposit berthed packets into the chart trees, and librarian's code to embed; depositing is codemother acting, so it is a codemother bus verb, and an embed is an inference_domain verb.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a device's interface is the bus) via parent 8e3474a6ae43; Law 6 (codemother owns the tree writes her machines make; the chart skill asks rather than reaching into her hands); Law 1 (the stage dispatch moves once, unchanged).
how: Measured 2026-10-02 (encapsulation_breaches(Path('.').resolve()) from cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py): skills/chart/live.py carries the rows into cairn/devices/codemother/machines/{constrain,decompose,hypothesize,survey,orient,triage,validate,verdict} (lines 26-38 of live.py) and one into cairn/devices/librarian (line 42, librarian.live's embed_via_bus and embed_metered_via_bus). (1) NEW cairn/devices/codemother/deposit.py receives, moved from live.py with bodies unchanged: deposit_verdict, drain_pending, and the stage dispatch of _learn as one function deposit_berth(berth, *, nexus=None, embed, embed_metered) returning {'learn': got, 'berth': berth, 'nexus': nexus}; it imports the stage machines' deposit_*/..._node_content and verdict's mark_deposited, pending, validate_verdict, verdict_nexus, verdict_node_parts, VerdictRefused (all inside codemother), cairn.tools.tree.tree.deposit_learning, and cairn.tools.chain.grammar.CAIRN_ROOT. Its embed seams are two small functions over a bus handed in: embed(bus) -> text -> vector and embed_metered(bus) -> text -> {vector, tokens}, each one bus.request(to='inference_domain', verb='resolve', body={'kind': 'embed', 'prompt': text, 'model': <the model librarian's DEFAULT_MODEL names today, copied as a literal>, 'domain': 'research'}) — inference_domain's public interface, no librarian code. (2) cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py CodeMotherDevice.declared_verbs gains 'deposit' and 'drain'; _handle_deposit refuses (accepted False, a reason) a body without a berth or a berth not on disk, else returns {'accepted': True, 'verb': 'deposit', 'device': 'codemother', **deposit_berth(...)}; _handle_drain returns {'accepted': True, 'verb': 'drain', 'device': 'codemother', 'drained': drain_pending(embed=embed_metered(self._bus))}. declared_contract compiles from declared_verbs, so the announced menu gains both without a second edit. (3) skills/chart/live.py: _bus() reaches ('codemother', 'inference_domain') (one exchange, no beat — test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats keeps holding); _drain_before_serving sends verb 'drain' and prints the same DEPOSIT FAILED lines from the reply; _learn sends verb 'deposit' with {berth, nexus} and prints the same JSON (learn, berth, nexus, drained, dial aggregate) from the reply; counsel and moreabout embed through a local _embed(text) doing the inference_domain resolve request. live.py then imports nothing from cairn.devices. (4) cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py imports deposit_verdict and drain_pending from cairn.devices.codemother.deposit (its own device) instead of skills.chart.live. (5) skills/chart/intention+why.json and codemother's charter say where the deposit lives (through the door). Not this ticket's: codemother proof halves held by other components (codemothers-proof-halves-move-home); other skills' reaches.

decisions.text: D1 THE DEPOSIT MODULE: create cairn/devices/codemother/deposit.py. MOVE (cut from skills/chart/live.py, bodies unchanged) the two functions deposit_verdict and drain_pending, whole, docstrings included; the only line that changes inside them is drain_pending's default seam `embed = embed or embed_metered_via_bus(_bus())`, which becomes `embed = embed or embed_metered(reach("inference_domain"))`, and deposit_verdict's docstring sentence 'Lives HERE and not in verdict.py by construction:' says it lives in codemother's deposit module (moved by ticket e8fe361a5b2f) and not in verdict.py by construction. The module also defines, ABOVE them: EMBED_MODEL = "nomic-embed-text" (the literal librarian's DEFAULT_MODEL names today, copied, not imported); _SENDER = "codemother"; _resolve_embed(bus, text) doing `bus.request(sender=_SENDER, to="inference_domain", verb="resolve", why="codemother deposit embed", body={"kind": "embed", "prompt": text, "model": EMBED_MODEL, "domain": "research"})` and returning reply["body"]; embed(bus) returning a callable text -> _resolve_embed(...)["answer"]["vector"]; embed_metered(bus) returning a callable text -> {"vector", "tokens": provenance.counters.prompt_eval_count or None, "hit"} — the same two shapes librarian's embed_via_bus/embed_metered_via_bus return, without importing librarian. BELOW them: deposit_berth(berth, *, nexus=None, embed, embed_metered) whose body is live.py's _learn dispatch moved verbatim — from `with open(berth, encoding="utf-8") as fh: packet = json.load(fh)` through the if/elif chain over the berth basename prefixes constrain-, survey-, decompose-, triage-, hypothesize-, validate-, verdict-, else orient — with `embed_via_bus(_bus())` replaced by `embed` and `embed_metered_via_bus(_bus())` by `embed_metered`, and the orient branch's `nexus = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "orient"` becoming `nexus = nexus or "orient"`; it returns {"learn": got, "berth": berth, "nexus": nexus}. Imports: json, os; the stage machines' deposit_<stage> and <stage>_node_content exactly as live.py imported them (constrain, decompose, hypothesize, orient's deposit_orient, survey, triage, validate); from verdict.verdict VerdictRefused, mark_deposited, pending, validate_verdict, verdict_nexus, verdict_node_parts; cairn.tools.bus_client.reach; cairn.tools.chain.grammar.CAIRN_ROOT; cairn.tools.tree.tree.deposit_learning. Nothing from cairn.devices.librarian. The module docstring says it was moved from skills/chart/live.py by ticket e8fe361a5b2f under RULE 1 because writing nodes through codemother's machines is codemother acting.

decisions.text: D2 THE TWO VERBS: in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py, CodeMotherDevice.declared_verbs gains `"deposit": self._handle_deposit` and `"drain": self._handle_drain` after "feedback". Both handlers are methods placed directly above `def intention(self)` and import inside the method (as _handle_commit and _handle_question do). _handle_deposit(envelope): body = envelope.get("body", {}) or {}; berth = body.get("berth"); if berth is not a non-empty str return {"accepted": False, "verb": "deposit", "device": "codemother", "reason": "deposit needs a berth path in body.berth"}; if not os.path.isfile(os.path.expanduser(berth)) return the same shape with reason "berth %r is not on disk"; else bus = self._bus or reach("inference_domain"), call deposit_berth(berth, nexus=body.get("nexus"), embed=embed(bus), embed_metered=embed_metered(bus)) inside try/except Exception, an exception returning accepted False with reason "<ExcType>: <msg>", success returning {"accepted": True, "verb": "deposit", "device": "codemother", **out}. _handle_drain(envelope): bus = self._bus or reach("inference_domain"); return {"accepted": True, "verb": "drain", "device": "codemother", "drained": drain_pending(embed=embed_metered(bus))}. declared_contract compiles from declared_verbs, so the announced menu gains both with no second edit. `os` is already imported by shim.py.
decisions.step: unlisted: add deposit and drain verbs to CodeMotherDevice in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py

decisions.text: D3 LIVE.PY ASKS: in skills/chart/live.py delete the imports of every cairn.devices.codemother.machines.* module, `from cairn.tools.chain.grammar import (CAIRN_ROOT)`, and `from cairn.devices.librarian.live import embed_metered_via_bus, embed_via_bus`; `from cairn.tools.tree.tree import counsel, deposit_learning` becomes `... import counsel`. _bus() caches reach("codemother", "inference_domain") in _BUS (one exchange, no beat — cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py resets _BUS and calls _bus with beat stubbed to raise, and keeps holding). New module names: _SENDER = "chart"; EMBED_MODEL = "nomic-embed-text"; _embed(text) doing the inference_domain resolve request (same body as D1) and returning the vector; _ask_codemother(verb, body) doing _bus().request(sender=_SENDER, to="codemother", verb=verb, why="chart <verb>", body=body) and returning the reply body, a bounce (body.is_bounce) returned as {"accepted": False, "reason": ...}. _drain_before_serving: got = _ask_codemother("drain", {}); if not accepted, print 'DRAIN FAILED — codemother did not drain the pending verdicts: <reason>' to stderr and return [{"berth": None, "failed": <reason>, "still_pending": True}]; else drained = got["drained"] and the existing per-entry 'DEPOSIT FAILED — ... STANDS PENDING' stderr loop runs unchanged. _learn: after the drain, body = {"berth": os.path.abspath(berth)} plus "nexus": argv[1] when given; reply = _ask_codemother("deposit", body); not accepted prints 'DEPOSIT REFUSED — <berth>: <reason>' to stderr and returns 1; else got, nexus = reply["learn"], reply["nexus"] and the existing json print (learn, berth, nexus, drained, dial aggregate) runs unchanged. counsel and moreabout call _embed(x) where they called embed_via_bus(_bus())(x). The module docstring's paragraph naming librarian's embed_via_bus says embeds ride inference_domain's resolve verb and depositing is asked of codemother (ticket e8fe361a5b2f). After the build `grep -n cairn.devices skills/chart/live.py` returns nothing.
